errors.evidence: This statement claims the highest value for the "Други" (Other) series is 5,562. This is incorrect and is a consequence of the previous error. The actual highest value for this series is 5,460 in 2017.

In the description of the "Жилищни" (Residential) series, the value for 2017 is listed as 5,460. However, the chart shows the value for this gray line is 5,562. The value 5,460 belongs to the "Други" (Other) series for that year.
